sentences.en: The principle of the gapless linear transmission system was briefly described in this paper.

sentences.en: The excitation spectrum is gapless in superfluid phase whereas there is a gap in the Mott insulator phase. The critical velocities which are nonzero are relation of the different spin component.
sentences.vi: Phổ kích thích là không có khe hở trong pha siêu lỏng trong khi có khoảng trống trong pha cách điện Mott. Các vận tốc tới hạn khác không là quan hệ của các thành phần spin khác nhau.

sentences.en: It was proved that the problem of gapless case′s MSR is equivalent to compute the maximum independent set and independence number of its graph.

sentences.en: Things like gapless playback, 5-band equalizers,(www.Sentencedict.com) on-the-fly playlist creation and FLAC/OGG support are features that many of today's models can only envy.
